verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply this week; the cause is identified and being addressed.
narrative: This period delivered 7 tracked leads at a cost of $242.73 per lead — a significant step back from prior weeks, driven by a 58.66% reduction in Google Ads spend that pulled conversion volume down with it. Over the last 7 days specifically, leads fell 80% and cost per lead spiked 215%, confirming the paid search pullback as the primary mechanical cause. At the same time, zero leads came in across September 14–16 despite daily spend holding steady at roughly $44, which points to an audience or creative efficiency issue on Meta that we are actively investigating. Your Google Business Profile listings are also underperforming on call rates, and profile optimization work is underway to recover that organic floor. Pending milestones — including confirming an intake owner and re-enabling Local Services Ads — remain the key gates to restoring and then scaling volume; clearing those is the immediate focus ahead of heating season campaigns going live October 1.
